decision: Complete the audit only when every earlier requirement has a reviewed assessment and inspected sources; preserve all remaining gaps.
rationale: Passing claim checks did not establish complete workstream acceptance. A separate validated inventory makes this distinction inspectable.

discovery.observation: The user saw partial acceptance and missing implementation records after a summary said all claims passed.
discovery.regression: The inventory rejects omitted requirements, unsupported mappings, missing sources and contradictory totals.
